parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
Language type of the returned information:

- zh: Chinese
- en: English

parameters.name: OriginInstanceNamespace
parameters.description: Namespace list, required when the source cluster is Nacos.

parameters.description: Extended request parameters, in JSON format.
